GET.loss: n/a: a Get that never arrives changes nothing; a blocked Get cannot be abandoned (no cancellation API)
GET.delay: n/a: Get takes no deadline; waiting without bound is the GET disposition in the waiting rows
GET.duplication: n/a: every Get is an independent request; repeating Get is legitimate use
GET.out-of-order: n/a: a Get after Release is the GET cell of row Released
GET.contradiction: n/a as a column: concurrent Get with Put/Close/Release are pairs P-01, P-02, P-04, P-08
GET.commission: n/a: Get has no trigger other than the caller

PUT.out-of-order: n/a: a Put after Release is the PUT cell of row Released (the pool cannot reopen)

CLOSE.delay: n/a: a late Close only delays the decrement; the same as UV-02 for the capacity it holds

RELEASE.loss: n/a: a pool that is never released lives until the process ends; that is its normal lifetime
RELEASE.delay: n/a: Release has no deadline relation
RELEASE.duplication: n/a: a second Release is the RELEASE cell of row Released
RELEASE.out-of-order: n/a: there is no event after which Release would be stale
RELEASE.contradiction: n/a as a column: concurrent Release calls are pair P-09
RELEASE.commission: n/a: only the caller triggers it

LEN.loss: n/a: a query that does not arrive changes nothing
LEN.duplication: n/a: read-only, repeating is harmless by construction
LEN.out-of-order: n/a: a Len after Release is the LEN cell of row Released
LEN.commission: n/a: only the caller triggers it

PING.loss: n/a: a Ping call that does not arrive changes nothing
PING.delay: n/a: runs without the mutex, a slow Ping delays only its caller
PING.duplication: n/a: repeating a validation is legitimate
PING.out-of-order: n/a: a Ping after Release is the PING cell of row Released
PING.contradiction: n/a: read-only with respect to the pool
PING.commission: n/a: only the caller triggers it

FACTORY_OK.duplication: n/a: synchronous call, one result per call
FACTORY_OK.out-of-order: n/a: synchronous; no late result after the creating Get returned

CLOSEFN_OK.duplication: n/a: synchronous call, one result per call
CLOSEFN_OK.value: n/a: the only result is an error value, its non-nil case is UV-15

IDLE_TIMEOUT.loss: n/a: no timer exists that could fail
IDLE_TIMEOUT.delay: n/a: the IDLE_TIMEOUT column records the lazy handling itself
IDLE_TIMEOUT.duplication: n/a: a passage of time cannot repeat
IDLE_TIMEOUT.contradiction: n/a: one comparison per dequeued connection
IDLE_TIMEOUT.commission: n/a: no timer can fire spuriously
IDLE_TIMEOUT.value: n/a: wall-clock jumps do not affect the monotonic comparison (NAT-6)

pairs.trace: P-01a — Get registers as waiting, then Put
P-01b — Put lands between Get's empty select and Get's lock
P-02b — Release starts while a Get is in progress
P-04a — Close, then Get at the former cap
P-04b — Get waits, then Close frees capacity
P-05a — Put(c), then Close(c) by another goroutine
P-06b — Release called while Factory runs
P-07a — Idle time passes, then a Get dequeues the conn
P-07b — Get dequeues the conn just before the idle time passes
P-08a — Release clears the Ping reference before the Get reads it
P-08b — Get reads the Ping reference, Release clears it, Get calls Ping
P-09a — Release by caller 1, then Release by caller 2
P-09b — Release by caller 2, then Release by caller 1
